facts.fact: Ammu's seventh-night signal is an unsplit reed left in the cup of the meeting stone, meaning she has kept her word (distinct from the split reed 'show me', F162).

Neela tells Ammu a second lie: Devan did not turn round on the rampart because he was facing the terraces and thinks the passing animal was the fort's notched ginger tom. Ammu accepts it because she wants to.

Devan answers the rampart kiss aloud: he stayed still because she ran, not because he did not want to follow; he will not ask at dusk with resin on her, and tells her to find him in daylight when she wants it.
